name: Coming to Collect
summary: Friz’s debtor has gambled her money on Slugjaw in Gadgetzan’s arena and says the winnings are ready to collect. You are sent to speak with Fizbuz Mithril.

sections.title: Friz’s Money
sections.body: The gambler who owes Friz says he wagered her money on Slugjaw at Fizbuz’s arena in Gadgetzan. He claims the bet won, but says he has not collected the winnings. Since you are already running an errand for Friz, he asks you to speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.

faq.answer: A gambler owes Friz money after betting it on Slugjaw in Fizbuz’s arena.

faq.q: Why did he bet Friz’s money?
faq.answer: He says he thought betting on Slugjaw was a sound investment.
Slugjaw is the arena fighter the gambler bet on in Gadgetzan.
The gambler says he has not collected the winnings and sends you to speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Who should I speak to in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan about the winnings.
